_comment: A march's heading lag folded under an explicatio is squared afterwards. One loose-order, undisciplined Spearmen block (120 men, 30 files by 4 ranks) stands facing south in drill mode on an open, widened field (so the 60-file line it unfolds into stays on the field) and is ordered to a point 50 wu away, about 73 degrees east of south. An undisciplined march re-faces onto its bearing without a formed pivot, so when the order response ends the heading turns 72.4 degrees at once while the slot grid stays where the men stand and turns after it no faster than the men on its flank files can jog (Unit._reface, Unit._advance_grid_lag). The block is wide and Spearmen jog slowly, so that lag closes slowly: the block halts at tick 262 with its grid still 56.7 degrees off its heading. That lag is the march's own, not an order's re-square. At tick 266 it is given the quarter-turn and explicatio combo (Shift+E). The quarter-turn holds the lag while the men turn in place, so when the explicatio fires at tick 294 the grid stands 33.5 degrees off the new heading, nearer square than the quarter fold the lag was closing onto. The explicatio folds the lag where the grid stands, so the doubled files lie across the facing. On main a8c838e8 nothing squares that fold afterwards and the grid stays 33.5 degrees off its heading for the rest of the clip; now the file double leaves a re-square waiting, which turns the grid square at the bounded rate (0.0 degrees off from about tick 1400). The block's anchor drifts about 380 wu west-north-west after the explicatio; the camera follows it. The unfold itself is slow on both trees: the doubled loose line is about 2000 wu wide, its outer men start about 540 wu from their new slots, and at tick 1440 they still stand 364 wu from them on average on this branch (239 on main, whose grid does not turn), so the clip shows the men walking out toward a line square to their front rather than a settled line. Deeper, tighter blocks that settle sooner lose the lag before they halt or pass under the overlap floor while they unfold (a 600-man, 10-file tight column reads 0.96 wu, a 400-man NORMAL one 1.70), so this staging is the one that reaches the case with every verdict passing. Every verdict and figure below reads the same on seeds 0 to 4. Measured with 2-tick FULL state dumps (ticks 2 to 1500) on main a8c838e8 and on this branch, seeds 0 to 4, judged with no exemptions: the branch that added this clip passed every verdict on every seed, its closest two men 2.27 wu apart at tick 1170 against the 2.25 wu overlap floor; main fails the squared-grid expectation (33.5 degrees off at ticks 1440 to 1500) and the overlap floor (1.28 wu), on every seed. Since the file-line untangle (#1929; measured 2026-11-11 at 6537b594 against aef5b476, seeds 0 to 4, dense 2-tick dumps, no exemptions) the closest two men stay 3.48 wu apart, and every verdict passes except misslotted for uid 0 (0.425 against 0.25 from tick 888): the settled gate opens while the wings are still walking out, which the misslotted exemption below records (#1942).

misslotted.reason: The block (uid 0) doubles from 30 files to 60 at tick 294 after its quarter-turn, a line over 2,000 wu wide, and the men of its two wings walk out along it in single file for hundreds of wu (the farthest 543 wu), each about a pitch short of his own slot and so nearer the slot ahead. The misslot scan judges only once the block's mean distance to its nearest slot falls to a quarter of the spacing (9.0 wu); the men of each file now pair off side by side, so the inner men arrive sooner and that gate opens at tick 888 (8.99 wu) while the wings are still walking: misslotted 0.425 against 0.25, easing to 0.308 by tick 1050. Main walks the same men (0.433 at tick 888) but its mean is 10.58 wu, so its gate stays shut. No man's distance to his own slot rises by more than 0.6 wu between samples from tick 294, and 97 of 120 have arrived by tick 1500 on both trees. State ticks 888, 890 and 892 let this clip's own scan see it. Measured 2026-11-11 on branch claude/1929-wave18 at 6537b594 against main aef5b476, dense 2-tick dumps (misslot on seeds 0 to 4, the walk trace on seed 0); tracked in #1942.
